behavior: A field with more than one input, such as a radio group or a checkbox group, takes the first invalid input in the document, or else the first eligible input in the document. The field reads the validity of that input. A form that blocks the submit or gives an error to the field focuses the part of that input. Inputs in two trees, such as two shadow roots, keep the order of the registrations. Base UI takes the first input in the order of the registrations. That order differs from the document after a keyed move, after an input mounts before the other inputs, and for an input outside a branch that `Activity` shows again. A form then focuses an input that is not the first one, while Base UI's `Form` focuses the first invalid field by document position.
